why: A centred note "(This amendment also stood in the name of Dato Abdul Hamid.)" between amendments was read as a speaker because Dato matched anywhere in the label; the new titles now count only at the start of a label.

Section Name:BUDGET
Title:BUDGET, PUBLIC WORKS, NON-RECURRENT (GENERAL)
MPs Speaking:Dr Goh Keng Swee (Minister for Finance); Mr Tan Kia Gan (Minister for National Development); Dr Lee Siew Choh; Mr A. P. Rajah; Mr Low Por Tuck; Mr Ong Chang Sam; Sir George Oehlers (Mr Speaker);


    Mr Ong Chang Sam: Sir, can I take amendments* (7) to (11) together?
*Amendments (7) to (11), standing in the names of Mr Ong Chang Sum, reads as follows:

    (7) That the sum to allocated for Head D58 be reduced by $10 in respect of item (1) of subhead 11.

    (8) That the sum to allocated for Head D58 be reduced by $10 in respect of item (3) of subhead 11.
(This amendment also stood in the name of Dato Abdul Hamid.)


    (9) That the sum to allocated for Head D58 be reduced by $10 in respect of item (7) of subhead 11.

    (10) That the sum to be allocated for Head D58 be reduced by $10 in respect of item (6) of subhead 12.

    (11) That the sum to be allocated for Head D58 be reduced by $10 in respect of item (7) of subhead 12.


    The Chairman: Are they all connected?
